title: Colonizer agent event
description: The runner→agentd event contract of docs/protocol.md §2, plus the §6.2 memory_proposal and §6.6 finding additions, as one machine-readable document. One source of truth for three hand-kept sides (#73 item 4), only two of which this schema actually covers: the Claude Code runner (modules/agents/claude-code) is tested against the committed fixture modules/agents/claude-code/test/fixtures/events.jsonl, and the Rust harness deserialises the events it acts on into the AgentEvent enum (crates/colonizer/src/protocol.rs). The browser's hand-written AgentEventBody (web/src/types.ts) is not generated or checked from this schema: it declares every event type this schema defines, memory_proposal and finding included. Events a subagent produced may carry the agent ref, and events stored by agentd carry seq and ts (docs/protocol.md §3); neither is part of the runner contract body, so this schema does not enumerate them. Unknown fields and unknown types must be ignored for forward compatibility (§1), which is why additionalProperties is deliberately left open.

agent_ref.description: The subagent that produced the event: the Task tool call that started it (docs/protocol.md §2 rules). Omitted entirely on the orchestrator's own events, never null.

name.description: The subagent type, or its task description when the type was not named.

preview.description: Markdown or HTML, rendered monospace or sandboxed (§5).

options.description: Whatever the model produced, which the runner forwards unvalidated. The model is asked for 2-4 options and UIs always add 'Other' (§2 rules), but that count is a rule for the model, not a guarantee of this wire format.

model_tokens.description: Cumulative tokens one model spent as of the last turn end.

status.description: The agent's own state machine; must be emitted on every state change. agentd emits the same shape with detail set when the runner exits (§3).

user_message.description: The echo of an accepted message. Watchdog nudges are user_message echoes whose id starts with watchdog- (§6.3).

assistant_text_delta.description: Optional streaming; the final assistant_text supersedes the deltas.

thinking.description: Optional summary of the agent's thinking.

tool_call.description: AskUserQuestion never appears here: questions travel as question events (§2 rules).

question.description: A question that needs the user's answer; UIs always add a free-text 'Other' choice (§2 rules).

questions.description: Forwarded as the model produced them, so it can be empty or hold fewer options than the §2 rules ask the model for.

question_answered.description: The answer travelled browser ⇄ harness ⇄ agentd ⇄ runner (§2).

turn_end.description: A turn ended. cost_usd and model_usage are cumulative for the colony; cost_usd sums only the Claude models in model_usage (keys without a '/') (§2 rules).

log.description: Runner diagnostics (stderr, routing warnings, pre-flight scan findings); agentd uses the same shape for its own (§3).

memory_proposal.description: A proposed shared-memory note (§6.2); nothing is written inside the colony. Absent scope means repo; absent tags mean none.

finding.description: A confirmed problem outside the task (§6.6); the mothership files it as a GitHub issue because the token never enters the colony.

evidence.description: How the finding was confirmed, at most 5 000 characters; a finding without evidence is not filed.
